mapper.select: SELECT c.continent AS continentName, COUNT(th.travel_history_id) AS travelCount FROM travel_history th JOIN country c ON th.country_id = c.country_id WHERE th.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.continent ORDER BY travelCount DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(th.travel_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(th.travel_history_id) AS travelCount FROM travel_history th WHERE th.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(th.travel_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month
